snippet.title: Defilade Official Steam Trailer - a New RTS Game Coming!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5246700/Defilade/

Infantry uses cover like I've never seen before in any RTS game, if you know of deeper cover mechanics than this please let me know so I can learn from them! 

I’m Building an Old-School Isometric RTS Set in Modern Warfare and Beyond?

Game will be called Defilade

Join me on Patreon if you want to help with the funding of the game:  https://www.patreon.com/c/RBGames777

Join the Discord for more updates: https://discord.gg/chDHHJvj5

Join my X Account: https://x.com/Neucollective

Or my Ko-Fi for once off donations: https://ko-fi.com/rbgames


Thank you for being here!
